name: clickfix-example-react-native
description: ClickFix example: bare React Native app with @getclickfix/react-native (native screens and hooks, mobile app key, Keychain token).

scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output dist/index.android.bundle --assets-dest dist/res
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output dist/main.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/ios
